1. (Currently amended) An association method, comprising:
identifying candidate file sets from a plurality of application files, each candidate file set including a cluster of related but unrecognized application files, wherein the candidate file sets are identified based on __frequent patterns of file co-occurrence across the plurality of application files__;
presenting content indicative of each of the candidate file sets; and
associating an application with application files of one of the candidate file sets according to a detected selection of the content indicative of the one of the candidate file set.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the candidate file sets include at least one of a frequent file set, a common application package file set, a common version file set, and a common directory file set, __and wherein the candidate file sets are identified by analyzing file relationships and dependencies within the plurality of application files__.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein identifying candidate file sets comprises constructing a frequent pattern tree from the found application files and identifying the candidate file sets that are frequent file sets from the frequent pattern tree, __wherein the frequent pattern tree represents quantitative information about file co-occurrence patterns__.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein identifying candidate file sets comprises identifying candidate file sets having a support exceeding a predetermined threshold support, __wherein support is measured as a frequency of file co-occurrence within the plurality of application files__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein identifying candidate file sets comprises identifying candidate file sets of sizes exceeding a predetermined threshold size, __wherein size is measured by the number of files within each candidate file set__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein, for each identified candidate file set, the content presented for that candidate file set is indicative of at least one of a support and a size of the candidate file set, __and wherein the support and size information is derived from analysis of file relationships within the plurality of application files__.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the plurality of application files is a first plurality, the method comprising:
generating a rule based on the association between the application and its corresponding candidate file set, __wherein the rule encodes file patterns identified from the first plurality__;
and
processing the rule to automatically associate unrecognized files of a second plurality of application files with the application, __wherein the unrecognized files match the file patterns encoded in the rule__.

8. (Currently amended) A __non-transitory__ computer readable medium having instructions stored thereon that when executed by a processing resource implement a system comprising a file set engine, a presentation engine, and an association engine, wherein:
the file set engine is configured to examine a plurality of unrecognized files of two or more computing devices and identify candidate file sets from the plurality, __based on frequent patterns of file co-occurrence__, each candidate file set including a cluster of related but unrecognized application files;
the presentation engine is configured to present content indicative of each identified candidate file set; and
the association engine is configured to detect a selection of content indicative of one of the candidate file sets and associate an application with an application file of that one of the candidate file sets.

9. (Currently amended) The medium of claim 8, wherein the file set engine is configured to identify candidate file sets that include at least one of a frequent file set, a common application package file set, a common version file set, and a common directory file set, __and wherein the file set engine analyzes file relationships and dependencies to identify such candidate file sets__.

10. (Currently amended) The medium of claim 8, wherein the file set engine is configured to construct a data structure representing quantitative information about frequent patterns found within the set of unrecognized files and identify the candidate file sets that are frequent file sets from the data structure, __wherein the data structure encodes file co-occurrence frequencies and relationships__.

11. (Currently amended) The medium of claim 8, wherein the file set engine is configured to identify candidate file sets having a support exceeding a predetermined threshold, __wherein support is determined by measuring the frequency of file co-occurrence within the plurality of unrecognized files__.

12. (Currently amended) The medium of claim 8, wherein the file set engine is configured to identify candidate file sets of sizes exceeding a predetermined threshold, __wherein size is determined by counting the number of files within each candidate file set__.

13. (Currently amended) The medium of claim 8, wherein, for each identified candidate file set, the presentation engine is configured to present content for that candidate file set that is indicative of at least one of a support and a file set size of the candidate file set, __and wherein the support and size are calculated from analysis of file relationships within the plurality of unrecognized files__.

14. (Currently amended) The medium of claim 8, wherein the plurality of application files is a first plurality, wherein the association engine is configured to generate a rule based on the association between the application and its corresponding candidate file set, __wherein the rule encodes file patterns identified from the first plurality__; and the system includes a recognition engine configured to process the rule to automatically associate unrecognized files of a second plurality of application files with the application, __wherein the unrecognized files match the file patterns encoded in the rule__.

15. (Currently amended) A system comprising a processing resource and a non-transitory computer readable medium and instructions stored on the medium, wherein the instructions, when executed, cause the processing resource to implement a method, comprising:
examining a plurality of unrecognized application files of two or more computing devices to identify candidate file sets from the plurality, __based on frequent patterns of file co-occurrence__;
presenting content indicative of each of the candidate file sets; and
associating an application with the application files of a given one of the candidate file sets according to a selection of the content indicative of that candidate file set.

16. (Currently amended) The system of claim 15, wherein the identified candidate file sets include at least one of a frequent file set, a common application package file set, a common version file set, and a common directory file set, __and wherein the candidate file sets are identified by analyzing file relationships and dependencies within the plurality of application files__.

17. (Currently amended) The system of claim 15, wherein examining comprises constructing a frequent pattern tree representing quantitative information about candidate patterns found within the set of unrecognized files and identifying the candidate file sets that are frequent file sets utilizing the frequent pattern tree, __wherein the frequent pattern tree encodes file co-occurrence frequencies and relationships__.

18. (Currently amended) The system of claim 15, wherein identifying the candidate file sets comprises identifying candidate file sets having a support exceeding a first predetermined threshold and a size exceeding a second predetermined threshold, __wherein support is measured by the frequency of file co-occurrence and size is measured by the number of files within each candidate file set__.

19. (Currently amended) The system of claim 15, wherein, for each identified candidate file set, the content presented for that candidate file set is indicative of at least one of a support and a file set size of the candidate file set, __and wherein the support and size are derived from analysis of file relationships within the plurality of application files__.

20. (Currently amended) The system of claim 15, wherein the plurality of application files is a first plurality and wherein the method further comprises:
generating a rule based on the association between the application and its associated candidate file set, __wherein the rule encodes file patterns identified from the first plurality__; and
processing the rule to automatically associate unrecognized files of a second plurality of application files with the application, __wherein the unrecognized files match the file patterns encoded in the rule__, the unrecognized files corresponding to one or more files of the corresponding candidate file set.
